title: Concrete Mix Proportioning - Guidelines (Second Revision)
scope: Guidelines for proportioning concrete mixes as per requirements using concrete materials including supplementary cementitious materials (fly ash, silica fume, GGBS). Covers standard concrete (M25 to M55), high strength concrete (M60 to M100), self-compacting concrete, and mass concrete.

clauses.title: Mix Design Parameters
clauses.text: Specifies compressive strength at 28 days, aggregate max size, slump workability, and max water-cement ratio.

clauses.title: Target Mean Strength
clauses.text: Calculates target compressive strength f'ck = fck + 1.65s.

title: Hardened Concrete - Methods of Test - Testing of Strength (Compressive, Flexural and Split Tensile Strength)
scope: Specifies procedures for testing compressive strength using concrete cubes (150mm) and cylinders (150x300mm), flexural strength of beam prisms, and split tensile strength with calibrated loading machines.

clauses.title: Compressive Strength
clauses.text: Loading rate of 14 N/mm2/min on 150mm cubes until failure.

clauses.title: Flexural Strength
clauses.text: Two-point symmetrical loading to determine modulus of rupture.

title: Fresh Concrete - Methods of Sampling, Testing and Analysis - Determination of Workability (Slump, Compacting Factor, Flow)
scope: Specifies test methods for determining workability of fresh concrete including slump test (standard slump cone), compacting factor test, Vee-Bee consistometer, and flow table test.

clauses.title: Slump Test Method
clauses.text: Four layer tamping with 16mm rod and vertical cone lifting to measure slump in mm.

clauses.title: Flow Table Test
clauses.text: Measures spread diameter of flowable self-leveling concrete.

title: Concrete Admixtures - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for chemical admixtures added to concrete mixes to modify workability, setting time, and strength. Covers accelerating, retarding, water-reducing (plasticizers), and superplasticizing admixtures (PCE / SNF).

clauses.title: Performance Criteria
clauses.text: Water reduction min 20% for superplasticizers; compressive strength min 110% of control.

clauses.title: Chloride Content
clauses.text: Chloride ion content in admixture capped at 0.2% for RCC.

title: Silica Fume - Specification
scope: Specifies chemical and physical requirements of silica fume (microsilica) used as mineral admixture in high-performance concrete. Regulates SiO2 content (min 85.0%), specific surface area (min 15 m2/g), and pozzolanic activity index.

clauses.title: Chemical Composition
clauses.text: SiO2 not less than 85.0%, available alkalis max 1.5%.

clauses.title: Physical Surface Area
clauses.text: Specific surface area by BET nitrogen adsorption min 15 m2/g.

title: Ground Granulated Blast Furnace Slag for Use in Concrete, Mortar and Grout - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for Ground Granulated Blast Furnace Slag (GGBS) utilized as cementitious replacement material (30% to 70%) in concrete. Regulates fineness by Blaine (min 320 m2/kg) and 28-day slag activity index (min 75%).

clauses.title: Slag Activity Index
clauses.text: 28-day slag activity index min 75% relative to OPC control.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: Specific surface area by Blaine method min 320 m2/kg.

title: Pulverized Fuel Ash - Specification - Part 1: For Use as Pozzolana in Cement and Concrete
scope: Covers requirements of fly ash from thermal power plants for use as pozzolanic material in concrete. Specifies SiO2+Al2O3+Fe2O3 min 70%, reactive silica min 20%, loss on ignition max 5.0%, and fineness min 320 m2/kg.

clauses.title: Chemical Properties
clauses.text: Total silica, alumina, and iron oxide min 70%; loss on ignition max 5.0%.

clauses.title: Fineness
clauses.text: Fineness by Blaine min 320 m2/kg.

title: Reinforcement Couplers for Mechanical Splices of Bars in Concrete - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for mechanical couplers connecting deformed steel reinforcing bars (IS 1786) in concrete structures without lap joints. Covers static tensile strength, slip test (max 0.10mm), and cyclic fatigue testing.

clauses.title: Tensile Capacity
clauses.text: Splice must achieve rebar rupture outside coupler sleeve at 100% yield strength.

clauses.title: Slip Test
clauses.text: Total coupler slip under 0.60 fy tensile load not exceeding 0.10 mm.

title: Fusion Bonded Epoxy Coated Reinforcing Bars - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for steel bars coated with fusion bonded epoxy (FBEC) for concrete structures in marine, coastal, and aggressive environments. Specifies coating thickness (175 to 300 microns) and holiday testing.

clauses.title: Coating Thickness
clauses.text: Film thickness between 175 and 300 microns on deformations.

clauses.title: Continuity Testing
clauses.text: High voltage holiday detector registering zero pinholes per meter.

title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
scope: Specifies nominal dimensions, sectional areas, weights per meter, and geometrical properties for hot-rolled steel sections: ISMB (Medium Beams), ISMC (Channels), and ISA (Angles).

clauses.title: Beam Sections
clauses.text: Dimensions and properties for ISMB and ISWB beams up to 600mm depth.

clauses.title: Channels and Angles
clauses.text: Dimensions for ISMC channels and ISA equal/unequal angles.

title: Hollow Steel Sections for Structural Use - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for hot finished and cold formed welded hollow steel sections (SHS, RHS, and CHS) from structural steel grades YSt 210, 240, 310, and 355 for airports, stadiums, and PEB buildings.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties
clauses.text: Yield strength min 210 to 355 MPa, elongation 10% to 20%.

clauses.title: Tolerances
clauses.text: Tolerances on outer dimensions (+-1%) and corner squareness.

title: High Strength Structural Bolts - Specification (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies property class 8.8 and 10.9 high strength structural hexagon bolts with large width across flats (M16 to M36) utilized with hardened washers in slip-critical friction grip connections for steel bridges.

clauses.title: Mechanical Properties
clauses.text: Class 8.8 tensile strength min 800 N/mm2; Class 10.9 tensile min 1040 N/mm2.

clauses.title: Proof Load
clauses.text: Must withstand proof load without permanent elongation under wedge loading.

title: High Strength Structural Nuts - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for high strength structural nuts of property class 8, 10, and 12 (sizes M16 to M36) matching high strength structural bolts in slip-resistant structural joints.

clauses.title: Proof Load Testing
clauses.text: Nuts sustain specified proof load without thread stripping.

clauses.title: Hardness
clauses.text: Rockwell hardness max 32 HRC for Class 8, max 36 HRC for Class 10.

title: Hardened and Tempered Washers for High Strength Structural Bolts and Nuts - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for through-hardened and tempered structural washers (sizes M16 to M36) used under bolt heads and nuts in friction-type preloaded structural joints.

clauses.title: Hardness
clauses.text: Quenched and tempered to achieve core hardness 35 to 45 HRC.

clauses.title: Dimensions
clauses.text: Strict dimensional tolerances on inner hole and outer diameter.

title: Design Loads for Buildings and Structures - Code of Practice - Part 3: Wind Loads
scope: Specifies wind force calculations on industrial sheds, high-rise buildings, towers, and bridges. Covers basic wind speed Vb (33 to 55 m/s), terrain factors k1, k2, k3, k4, and pressure coefficients.

clauses.title: Design Wind Pressure
clauses.text: Vz = Vb * k1 * k2 * k3 * k4; Design wind pressure pz = 0.6 * Vz^2.

clauses.title: Roof Pressure Coefficients
clauses.text: Internal and external wind pressure coefficients for canopies and pitched roofs.

title: Design and Construction of Pile Foundations - Concrete Piles (Bored Cast In-situ Concrete Piles)
scope: Covers design, installation, bentonite slurry drilling, tremie concreting, and testing of bored cast in-situ concrete piles. Mandates concrete grade min M25, slump 150-200mm, and pile socketing into bedrock.

clauses.title: Pile Load Capacity
clauses.text: Ultimate load capacity calculated from end bearing and skin friction.

clauses.title: Tremie Concreting
clauses.text: Continuous tremie pouring keeping pipe submerged min 2m into wet concrete.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Determination of Liquid and Plastic Limits
scope: Specifies laboratory testing for Liquid Limit (LL) using Casagrande liquid limit apparatus and Plastic Limit (PL) by rolling 3mm soil threads to determine soil Plasticity Index (PI = LL - PL).

clauses.title: Liquid Limit Test
clauses.text: Drop rate of 2 drops per second in brass cup to determine moisture at 25 blows.

clauses.title: Plastic Limit Test
clauses.text: Rolling soil paste into 3mm diameter threads on glass plate until crumbling.

title: Methods of Test for Soils - Laboratory Determination of CBR (California Bearing Ratio)
scope: Specifies method for testing California Bearing Ratio (CBR) of compacted soil subgrade under 4-day soaked conditions for highway pavement design. Regulates plunger penetration at 1.25 mm/min.

clauses.title: Soaking Method
clauses.text: 4-day water immersion under surcharge discs simulating pavement thickness.

clauses.title: Penetration Test
clauses.text: Standard plunger (50mm dia) driven at 1.25 mm/min measuring load at 2.5mm and 5mm.

title: Bitumen Emulsion for Roads (Cationic Type) - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Specifies physical requirements and test methods for cationic bitumen emulsions used in road maintenance for tack coat, prime coat, surface dressing, and cold mix premix carpeting. Covers RS-1, RS-2, MS, and SS grades.

clauses.title: Sieve Residue
clauses.text: Residue retained on 300-micron sieve not exceeding 0.05% by mass.

clauses.title: Particle Charge
clauses.text: Positive particle charge verification using DC electrodes confirming cationic formulation.

title: Adhesives for Use with Ceramic, Mosaic and Stone Tiles - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements for polymer modified cementitious tile adhesives (Type 1 to Type 5) for fixing vitrified and natural stone tiles with high shear bond strength.

clauses.title: Tensile Adhesion
clauses.text: Tensile adhesion strength min 1.0 N/mm2 under dry and wet immersion conditions.

clauses.title: Shear Adhesion
clauses.text: Shear bond strength exceeding 1.25 N/mm2.

title: Pressed Ceramic Tiles - Specification (First Revision)
scope: Specifies dimensions, surface quality, water absorption (< 0.5% for vitrified), modulus of rupture, deep abrasion resistance, and chemical resistance for ceramic floor and wall tiles.

clauses.title: Water Absorption
clauses.text: Group B1a vitrified tiles water absorption not exceeding 0.5%.

clauses.title: Modulus of Rupture
clauses.text: Flexural rupture strength min 35 N/mm2.

title: Gypsum Plaster Boards - Specification - Part 1: Plain Gypsum Plaster Boards
scope: Specifies requirements for paper-faced gypsum plasterboard panels utilized for false ceilings, interior drywall partitions, and sound insulation. Prescribes flexural breaking load and fire resistance.

clauses.title: Flexural Breaking Load
clauses.text: Transverse and longitudinal breaking load verification under three-point bending.

clauses.title: Core Cohesion
clauses.text: Paper-to-core bonding integrity under elevated humidity.

title: Plywood for Concrete Shuttering Work - Specification (Third Revision)
scope: Specifies boiling waterproof (BWP grade) phenolic bonded plywood panels designed for repeated concrete formwork shuttering. Prescribes cross-break tensile strength and static bending MOE.

clauses.title: Bonding Quality
clauses.text: Resistant to 72 hours continuous boiling water immersion without delamination.

clauses.title: Surface Coating
clauses.text: Phenolic film overlay providing smooth concrete finish.

title: Geotextiles for Subgrade Stabilization and Highway Pavements - Specification
scope: Specifies non-woven and woven polymeric geotextile membranes used for subgrade soil separation, filtration, and road base reinforcement under expressways to prevent aggregate sinking.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength
clauses.text: Wide width tensile strength min 15 to 30 kN/m; elongation at break 50%.

clauses.title: Apparent Opening Size
clauses.text: Pore opening size AOS for soil filtration retaining subgrade fines.

title: Dry-Type Power Transformers - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for dry-type and cast resin transformers (CRT) up to 33 kV rating utilized inside high-rise commercial complexes, underground metro stations, and hospitals where fire hazards must be eliminated.

clauses.title: Insulation Class
clauses.text: Class F (155 deg C) or Class H (180 deg C) non-flammable epoxy resin insulation.

clauses.title: Fire Behavior
clauses.text: Class F1 fire behavior self-extinguishing without toxic gas emissions.

title: Current Transformers - Part 1: General Requirements (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for measuring and protective current transformers (CTs) for indoor and outdoor switchgear from 415V to 400 kV. Regulates accuracy classes (0.2, 0.5, 5P, 10P), short-time thermal current, and instrument security factor.

clauses.title: Accuracy Classes
clauses.text: Class 0.2S and 0.5S for tariff metering; Class 5P10 and 5P20 for differential protection.

clauses.title: Short Time Thermal Current
clauses.text: Withstand symmetrical short circuit current for 1 or 3 seconds without damage.

title: Voltage Transformers - Part 1: General Requirements (Second Revision)
scope: Specifies requirements for electromagnetic potential transformers (PTs) and capacitive voltage transformers (CVTs) for power measurement and relay protection on 11 kV, 33 kV, 66 kV, 132 kV, and 220 kV systems.

clauses.title: Accuracy Limits
clauses.text: Voltage ratio error and phase displacement for Class 0.2, 0.5, 3P.

clauses.title: Rated Burden
clauses.text: Standard burdens (10 VA to 100 VA) and rated voltage factor.

title: Low-Voltage Switchgear and Controlgear Assemblies - Part 1: General Rules
scope: Standard governing type-tested low-voltage switchboards, power distribution boards (PDB), and motor control centers (MCC). Specifies temperature rise verification, short-circuit withstand strength (up to 50 kA for 1 sec), creepage distances, and internal separation forms (Form 1 to Form 4b).

clauses.title: Verification of Temperature Rise
clauses.text: Limits maximum temperature rise of copper busbars to 105 deg C under full load.

clauses.title: Short-Circuit Withstand
clauses.text: Dynamic and thermal short-circuit withstand test on busbar assembly.

title: Low Voltage Fuses for Voltages Not Exceeding 1000 V AC - Part 2: Fuses for Use by Authorized Persons (HRC Fuses)
scope: Specifies high rupturing capacity (HRC) link fuses (blade contact and bolted type) with breaking capacity min 80 kA at 415 V AC for industrial distribution networks, capacitor banks, and motor protection.

clauses.title: Breaking Capacity
clauses.text: Tested breaking capacity not less than 80 kA at rated power factor.

clauses.title: Cut-off and I2t Characteristics
clauses.text: Pre-arcing and total let-through energy limits for semiconductor protection.

title: Luminaires Performance - Part 2: Particular Requirements - Section 1: LED Luminaires
scope: Specifies performance and photometric requirements for LED street lights, LED floodlights, and LED high-bay lights. Prescribes luminaire luminous efficacy (min 100 to 140 lumens/watt), color rendering index (CRI > 70 or 80), correlated color temperature (CCT 3000K to 6500K), power factor (> 0.95), and total harmonic distortion (THD < 10%).

clauses.title: Photometric Efficacy
clauses.text: Luminous efficacy not less than 120 lm/W for street lights and high bays.

clauses.title: Electrical Characteristics
clauses.text: Operating voltage 120V to 300V AC; THD < 10% and surge protection min 4 kV/10 kV.

title: Safety of Lamp Controlgear - Particular Requirements for DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Mandatory safety standard for LED drivers. Regulates insulation resistance, electric strength, fault condition protection, short-circuit protection, over-voltage protection, and thermal protection against overheating.

clauses.title: Fault Conditions
clauses.text: Driver must not catch fire, emit flammable gases, or produce electric shock under open or short circuit.

clauses.title: Overvoltage Protection
clauses.text: Withstand continuous over-voltage up to 320 V AC without component failure.

title: Protection Against Lightning - Part 1: General Principles
scope: Specifies fundamental principles for lightning protection of structures, human beings, and internal electrical and electronic equipment. Covers lightning risk assessment, Lightning Protection Levels (LPL I to IV), surge protection zones (LPZ 0A, 0B, 1, 2), and coordinated surge protective devices (SPD).

clauses.title: Lightning Protection Levels (LPL)
clauses.text: LPL I: Peak current 200 kA with 99% probability of interception.

clauses.title: Surge Protection Zones
clauses.text: Step-by-step attenuation of electromagnetic pulse (LEMP) using Type 1, Type 2, and Type 3 SPDs.

title: A.C. Static Direct Connected and Transformer Operated Watthour and VAR-Hour Smart Meters - Specification
scope: Specifies technical requirements for static smart energy meters for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI). Covers bidirectional net metering, time-of-day (TOD) tariff registers, load survey, power quality event logging, tamper detection, internal disconnect/reconnect latching relay, and optical/cellular communication ports.

clauses.title: Metrological Accuracy
clauses.text: Class 1.0 and 2.0 direct connected; Class 0.5S and 0.2S transformer operated smart meters.

clauses.title: Smart Features
clauses.text: Latching relay operation for remote load connect/disconnect up to 60A; optical and RF/GPRS interfaces.

title: Electric Monobloc Pumpsets for Clean, Cold Water - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for close-coupled electric motor driven monobloc centrifugal pumpsets for municipal water supply and residential overhead tank filling. Regulates hydraulic efficiency and electrical safety.

clauses.title: Overall Efficiency
clauses.text: Total efficiency of pump and motor combined verifying star energy rating.

clauses.title: Thermal Overload Protection
clauses.text: Built-in thermal overload protector (TOP) in motor winding preventing burnout.

title: Vertical Turbine Pumps for Clear, Cold, Fresh Water - Specification
scope: Specifies vertical turbine pumps (oil lubricated and water lubricated line shaft) for deep sumps, irrigation canals, thermal power plant cooling water intake, and industrial raw water intake.

clauses.title: Bowl and Impeller
clauses.text: Enclosed or semi-open bronze/stainless steel impellers dynamically balanced.

clauses.title: Thrust Bearing
clauses.text: Heavy duty spherical roller or tilting pad thrust bearing absorbing hydraulic up-thrust and down-thrust.

title: Swing Check Type Reflux (Non-Return) Valves for Water Works Purposes - Specification - Part 1: Single Door Pattern
scope: Specifies requirements for cast iron and ductile iron single door swing check reflux valves (DN 50 to DN 600) to prevent reverse water flow and water hammer in pumping mains.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Test
clauses.text: Body test at 1.5 times rating and seat test at rated pressure without seepage.

clauses.title: Door Closure
clauses.text: Quick positive closure without slamming or vibration during pump trip.

title: Code for Unfired Pressure Vessels
scope: Design, construction, inspection, and testing code for unfired cylindrical and spherical steel pressure vessels utilized in chemical refineries, gas storage terminals, air receivers, and thermal power plants.

clauses.title: Design Categories
clauses.text: Class I (fully radiographed), Class II, and Class III vessels based on pressure and hazard.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Proof Test
clauses.text: Hydrostatic test at 1.3 to 1.5 times maximum allowable working pressure.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases - Part 1: Cylinders for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)
scope: Specifies materials, deep drawing, circumferential welding, heat treatment (stress relieving / normalizing), hydrostatic stretch test, and burst test for domestic (14.2 kg) and commercial (19 kg / 47.5 kg) LPG cylinders.

clauses.title: Hydrostatic Stretch Test
clauses.text: Hydrostatic stretch testing at 2.5 MPa measuring permanent volumetric expansion <= 10%.

clauses.title: Burst Test
clauses.text: Minimum burst pressure exceeding 4.0 MPa with ductile tearing and zero fragmentation.

title: Refillable Seamless Steel Gas Cylinders - Part 2: Quenched and Tempered Steel Cylinders with Tensile Strength Less Than 1100 MPa
scope: Specifies manufacture and testing of seamless alloy steel gas cylinders for high-pressure industrial and medical gases (Oxygen, Nitrogen, Hydrogen, Argon, Helium, CNG) up to 300 bar working pressure.

clauses.title: Hydraulic Proof Pressure Test
clauses.text: Every cylinder subjected to test pressure of 1.5 times working pressure.

clauses.title: Ultrasonic Examination
clauses.text: 100% full body ultrasonic wall thickness and defect verification.

title: Hexagon Head Bolts, Screws and Nuts of Product Grades A and B - Part 1: Hexagon Head Bolts
scope: Specifies high precision precision-machined hexagon bolts of Product Grades A (up to M24) and B (above M24) for critical automotive, aerospace, and machine tool assemblies.

clauses.title: Precision Tolerances
clauses.text: Strict tolerance on shank runout, bearing surface perpendicularity, and thread pitch.

clauses.title: Property Classes
clauses.text: High tensile property classes 8.8, 10.9, and 12.9 alloy steels.

title: Hexagon Socket Head Cap Screws - Specification (Fifth Revision)
scope: Specifies dimensions and mechanical properties for Allen socket head cap screws (sizes M1.6 to M64) of property class 12.9 high tensile alloy steel for dies, molds, fixtures, and machine tools.

clauses.title: Socket Dimensions
clauses.text: Precision hexagonal socket dimensions and depth withstanding rated tightening torque.

clauses.title: Tensile Strength
clauses.text: Class 12.9 minimum tensile strength 1220 N/mm2 and Rockwell hardness 39 to 44 HRC.

title: Code of Practice for Electric Overhead Travelling Cranes and Gantry Cranes (Second Revision)
scope: Design, fabrication, erection, and testing code for electric overhead travelling (EOT) cranes, gantry cranes, and semi-gantry cranes. Classifies crane duties (Class 1 light duty to Class 4 continuous steel mill duty), structural girder deflection limits, hoisting speeds, and electrical brakes.

clauses.title: Structural Design
clauses.text: Bridge girder vertical deflection under safe working load (SWL) not exceeding 1/1000 of span.

clauses.title: Hoisting Mechanism
clauses.text: Factor of safety min 5 on wire ropes; dual electro-mechanical fail-safe brakes on hoist.

title: Room Air Conditioners - Specification - Part 1: Unitary Air Conditioners (Window Air Conditioners)
scope: Specifies rating, construction, safety, maximum power consumption, and cooling capacity for window air conditioners. Covers BEE star rating energy efficiency ratio (ISEER), noise levels, and refrigerant leakage tightness.

clauses.title: Cooling Capacity Test
clauses.text: Psychrometric calorimeter testing verifying rated cooling capacity within +-5%.

clauses.title: Energy Efficiency (ISEER)
clauses.text: Minimum Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio for 3-star and 5-star ratings.

title: Room Air Conditioners - Specification - Part 2: Split Air Conditioners
scope: Specifies requirements for residential and commercial split-type air conditioners (indoor high-wall / cassette unit and outdoor inverter compressor condensing unit). Prescribes inverter compressor performance, ISEER ratings, and safety.

clauses.title: Inverter Performance
clauses.text: Cooling capacity under full load and 50% half load conditions across 24 deg C to 43 deg C ambient.

clauses.title: Electrical Safety
clauses.text: Conformity to dielectric strength, earth continuity, and enclosure IPX4 outdoor weather resistance.

title: Selection, Installation and Maintenance of Automatic Fire Detection and Alarm System - Code of Practice
scope: Code of practice for conventional and addressable automatic fire alarm systems in buildings. Specifies spacing and placement of optical smoke detectors, heat detectors, multi-sensor detectors, manual call points (MCP), sounder strobes, and fire alarm control panels (FACP).

clauses.title: Detector Spacing
clauses.text: Smoke detector coverage max 80 m2; heat detector coverage max 50 m2 in open spaces.

clauses.title: Control Panel (FACP)
clauses.text: Primary AC power with 24V DC battery backup supporting 24-hour monitoring plus 30-minute full alarm.

title: Information Security, Cybersecurity and Privacy Protection - Information Security Management Systems - Requirements
scope: International standard specifying requirements for establishing, implementing, maintaining, and continually improving an Information Security Management System (ISMS) across government departments, cloud data centers, and enterprise IT networks.

clauses.title: Information Security Risk Assessment
clauses.text: Systematic methodology to identify, analyze, and evaluate cybersecurity risks and threat vectors.

clauses.title: Operational Security
clauses.text: Implementation of risk treatment plan and baseline controls defined in Annex A.

title: Information Security, Cybersecurity and Privacy Protection - Information Security Controls
scope: Code of practice providing a comprehensive set of 93 information security controls divided into 4 themes: Organizational controls, People controls, Physical controls, and Technological controls (access control, cryptography, vulnerability management, cloud security).

clauses.title: Organizational Controls
clauses.text: Policies, access management, asset management, and information classification rules.

clauses.title: Technological Controls
clauses.text: Endpoint security, privileged access management, secure coding, web filtering, and multi-factor authentication.

title: Information Technology - Security Techniques - Code of Practice for Information Security Controls for Cloud Services
scope: Provides guidelines on information security controls applicable to the provisioning and use of cloud computing services (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) for cloud service providers (CSP) and cloud customers (Government / Enterprise tenants).

clauses.title: Shared Roles and Responsibilities
clauses.text: Clear demarcation of security responsibilities between cloud provider and tenant.

clauses.title: Cloud Virtual Environment Security
clauses.text: Virtual machine isolation, hypervisor security, and segregation of tenant virtual networks.

title: Information Technology - Security Techniques - Code of Practice for Protection of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in Public Clouds
scope: Specifies privacy controls and guidelines for public cloud service providers acting as PII processors under data protection legislation (DPDP Act). Forbids unauthorized commercial use of citizen data and mandates encryption at rest and in transit.

clauses.title: Customer Consent and Control
clauses.text: PII shall not be processed for advertising or marketing without explicit customer authorization.

clauses.title: Data Encryption and Erasure
clauses.text: Strong cryptographic shredding and secure data destruction upon contract termination.

title: Data Privacy Assurance - Part 1: Engineering and Management Requirements
scope: Indigenous Indian standard for data privacy by design and default in software applications, digital platforms, and citizen databases conforming to the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act. Mandates privacy governance, data minimization, and consent architecture.

clauses.title: Privacy by Design
clauses.text: Systems engineered to collect only minimal necessary personal data and enforce automated retention schedules.

clauses.title: Consent Management
clauses.text: Granular, notice-based affirmative consent collection and simple withdrawal mechanisms.

title: Cybersecurity Framework for Smart Grid and Industrial SCADA Automation Systems
scope: Comprehensive cybersecurity standard for SCADA, Distributed Control Systems (DCS), power grid substations, and smart water networks. Prescribes network segmentation (Purdue model), secure remote access, encrypted protocols (IEC 61850 / DNP3 Secure), and intrusion detection.

clauses.title: Network Segmentation (Zones & Conduits)
clauses.text: Demarcation of OT industrial control networks from enterprise IT networks via industrial firewalls and data diodes.

clauses.title: Protocol Encryption
clauses.text: End-to-end cryptographic authentication for remote tele-control commands preventing grid sabotage.

title: Cryptographic Hardware Security Tokens - Specification (USB Crypto Tokens and Hardware Security Modules HSM)
scope: Specifies security, cryptographic performance, and physical tamper resistance for cryptographic hardware devices (FIPS 140-2 / 140-3 Level 3 compliant USB e-tokens and network HSM appliances) utilized for Class 3 Digital Signatures, PKI, and Aadhaar authentication.

clauses.title: Tamper Resistance
clauses.text: Zeroization of cryptographic keys upon physical enclosure penetration or environmental fault injection.

clauses.title: Cryptographic Algorithms
clauses.text: Hardware acceleration of RSA (2048/4096 bit), ECC (Curve P-256/384), and SHA-256/384/512.

title: Biometric Data Interchange Formats - Part 1: Framework
scope: Specifies common architectural framework and data record syntaxes for biometric data interchange in national ID programs (Aadhaar / UIDAI), immigration e-passports, and border security. Establishes CBEFF header formats and biometric quality blocks.

clauses.title: CBEFF Data Structure
clauses.text: Common Biometric Exchange Formats Framework packaging patron format, creation date, and device ID.

clauses.title: Interoperability Checks
clauses.text: Ensures cross-vendor match-on-card and server-side matching compatibility.

title: Biometric Data Interchange Formats - Part 4: Finger Image Data
scope: Specifies uncompressed and WSQ compressed optical and capacitive finger image data records (500 dpi resolution, 256 grey levels) for biometric enrollment and verification in banking, civil identity, and attendance.

clauses.title: Image Quality and Resolution
clauses.text: Spatial resolution 500 dpi +-1%; geometric distortion < 1.0%.

clauses.title: Compression Standard
clauses.text: Wavelet Scalar Quantization (WSQ) compression maintaining 15:1 ratio without feature loss.

title: Biometric Data Interchange Formats - Part 6: Iris Image Data
scope: Specifies near-infrared (NIR 700-900nm) optical capture requirements, pupil-to-iris contrast ratio, resolution (min 12 pixels per mm on eye), and raw/JPEG2000 image data structures for contact-less dual iris scanners.

clauses.title: Optical Capture Parameters
clauses.text: Near-infrared wavelength 700nm to 900nm with eye-safety illumination within IEC 62471 limits.

clauses.title: Iris Resolution
clauses.text: Iris diameter not less than 170 pixels in stored rectangular image.

title: Point of Sale (POS) Terminals - Specification (Hardware Security, EMV and Contactless NFC)
scope: Specifies hardware, security, and wireless communication standards for handheld and countertop POS payment terminals. Mandates PCI-PTS compliance, EMV Contactless Level 1 & 2 certification, secure cryptoprocessor, and encrypted PIN pad (EPP).

clauses.title: Payment Interface Compliance
clauses.text: Dual interface supporting magnetic stripe, EMV contact smart card (ISO 7816), and NFC contactless (ISO 14443).

clauses.title: Physical Security and Tamper Protection
clauses.text: Sensors detecting case opening, light intrusion, or drilling that instantly wipe encryption keys.

title: Information Technology - Generic Cabling for Customer Premises - Part 1: General Requirements
scope: Specifies structured cabling design rules, transmission performance, and topology for commercial office buildings, campus networks, and enterprise data centers. Covers horizontal cabling, backbone cabling, telecommunications rooms, and work areas.

clauses.title: Channel Performance
clauses.text: Specifies maximum channel length (100 meters) and insertion loss limits up to 500 MHz.

clauses.title: Cabling Topology
clauses.text: Hierarchical star topology linking Central Campus Distributor (CD) to Floor Distributors (FD).

title: Information Technology - Generic Cabling for Customer Premises - Balanced Twisted Pair Cabling (Category 6 and 6A)
scope: Specifies physical construction and electrical transmission benchmarks for 4-pair 100-ohm Category 6 (Cat6 up to 250 MHz) and Category 6A (Cat6A up to 500 MHz for 10 Gigabit Ethernet) UTP and STP cables and RJ45 modular jacks.

clauses.title: Transmission Benchmarks
clauses.text: Prescribes Insertion Loss, Return Loss, NEXT (Near-End Crosstalk), and PS-ANEXT (Alien Crosstalk) up to 500 MHz.

clauses.title: Connecting Hardware (RJ45)
clauses.text: Gold plating min 50 micro-inches on connector pins sustaining 750 mating cycles.

title: Optical Fibres - Part 2: Product Specifications - Section 50: Category B Single-Mode Fibres (OS1 and OS2)
scope: Specifies dimensional, optical, and environmental requirements for single-mode optical fibres (ITU-T G.652D zero water peak and G.657 bend insensitive) used in national telecom backbones, railway signalling, and FTTH networks.

clauses.title: Attenuation Limits
clauses.text: Maximum attenuation 0.35 dB/km at 1310 nm and 0.21 dB/km at 1550 nm.

clauses.title: Mode Field Diameter and Cladding
clauses.text: Cladding diameter 125.0+-0.7 microns; core-clad concentricity error <= 0.5 micron.

title: Optical Fibre Cables - Part 3: Outdoor Cables - Specification (Armoured Underground and Aerial Cables)
scope: Specifies mechanical strength and environmental protection for outdoor underground armoured and self-supporting aerial (ADSS) optical fibre cables (12F to 288F). Regulates tensile pull load, crush resistance, water penetration, and rodent protection.

clauses.title: Mechanical Tests
clauses.text: Tensile pull test (min 1500 N to 3000 N) and crush resistance (2000 N/100mm) without fibre breakage.

clauses.title: Water Penetration Test
clauses.text: Water blocking tape/jelly preventing water migration beyond 1 meter under 1-meter hydrostatic head for 24 hours.

title: Information Technology - Local and Metropolitan Area Networks - Part 2: Carrier Sense Multiple Access with Collision Detection (CSMA/CD) Access Method and Physical Layer Specifications (Ethernet)
scope: Specifies physical and data link layer standards for 10 Mbps, 100 Mbps (Fast Ethernet), 1000 Mbps (Gigabit Ethernet), and 10 Gbps Ethernet switching networks. Governs frame formats, MAC addressing, full-duplex flow control, and autonegotiation.

clauses.title: MAC Frame Architecture
clauses.text: Standard 802.3 MAC frame format with 48-bit addressing and 32-bit CRC frame check sequence.

clauses.title: Full Duplex Operation
clauses.text: PAUSE frame flow control preventing buffer overflow in high-throughput enterprise switches.

title: Systems and Software Engineering - Systems and Software Quality Requirements and Evaluation (SQuaRE) - System and Software Quality Models
scope: De-facto software engineering quality framework used for government e-Governance portals, mobile apps, and enterprise software audits. Establishes 8 quality characteristics: Functional Suitability, Performance Efficiency, Compatibility, Usability, Reliability, Security, Maintainability, and Portability.

clauses.title: Software Quality Model
clauses.text: Decomposes software into 8 characteristics and 31 sub-characteristics for testing.

clauses.title: Security and Reliability
clauses.text: Measures fault tolerance, recoverability, confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity.

title: Systems and Software Engineering - Software Life Cycle Processes
scope: Comprehensive standard defining software development life cycle (SDLC) processes: Acquisition, Supply, Development (Agile/DevOps), Operation, Maintenance, Quality Assurance, and Configuration Management for public tenders.

clauses.title: System Life Cycle Processes
clauses.text: Requirements analysis, software architectural design, detailed coding, unit testing, and integration.

clauses.title: Supporting Processes
clauses.text: Independent verification and validation (IV&V), software configuration management, and audit.

title: Cloud Computing - Service Level Agreements (SLA) Framework and Security Metrics
scope: Standardizes SLA definitions, availability metrics (99.9% to 99.999% uptime), latency, throughput, Mean Time to Detect (MTTD), Mean Time to Recover (MTTR), and data portability requirements for government cloud (MeitY MeghRaj) procurement.

clauses.title: SLA Performance Metrics
clauses.text: Formulas for calculating service availability percentage and penalty credits for service downtime.

clauses.title: Data Portability and Exit Management
clauses.text: Zero vendor lock-in; standardized export of databases and virtual machines within 30 days.

title: Internet of Things (IoT) - Reference Architecture - Device Management, Edge Gateways and Communication Protocols
scope: Establishes architectural layers (Perception, Edge Computing, Transport, and Application) for smart city sensor networks, smart metering, and industrial IoT (IIoT). Governs lightweight protocols (MQTT, CoAP) and device lifecycle security.

clauses.title: Architectural Layers
clauses.text: Defines boundaries between sensor nodes, IoT edge gateways, message brokers, and analytics clouds.

clauses.title: Device Authentication and Firmware OTA
clauses.text: Cryptographic device identity and secure over-the-air (OTA) encrypted firmware updates.

title: Artificial Intelligence - Trustworthiness, Robustness, Bias Mitigation and Explainability Framework
scope: National standard defining benchmarks for trustworthy AI systems in public administration, automated document processing, biometric verification, and decision-support algorithms. Prescribes fairness audits, adversarial robustness, and transparency logging.

clauses.title: Transparency and Explainability
clauses.text: Mandates generation of human-interpretable justifications and confidence metrics for AI automated outputs.

clauses.title: Bias and Fairness Audits
clauses.text: Statistical parity and equal opportunity metrics ensuring zero demographic bias in predictive algorithms.
